title: Retain edited drafts when save or submit fails
problemCues: Failed save clears the form or reverts without telling the user
preconditions: Mutable record or form with network/adapter write
decision: Keep the user's draft visible after failure and offer retry. Distinguish cancelled work from completed writes.
exceptions: Idempotent deletes that cannot be locally reconstructed — then say so and offer undo if available
validatedBy: Pilot browser proof: failed save keeps field values
